implemented: Extended editMarkdownNestedPropertyValue with explicit numeric path segments for existing inline leaves inside block-style sequence maps.
Preserved sequence framing, indentation, comments, line endings, unknown siblings and unrelated source bytes by replacing only the selected leaf span.
Covered inline sequence-map entries and bare sequence-map items, while refusing scalar/flow entries, ambiguous nested mappings and structural sequence edits.
limitations: This remains bounded source-span editing, not full YAML dialect or structural editing: aliases, anchors, tags, multiline scalars, flow traversal, indentationless sequences and whole-block replacement remain source-only or refused.
Reference Obsidian open-edit-save-reopen comparison, cross-platform visible validation and full YAML dialect coverage remain pending.
